POWERS AND FUNCTIONS OF THE GOVERNORS ORDER 1999
POWERS AND FUNCTIONS OF THE GOVERNORS ORDER
1999
ORDER NO.
5 OF 1999
No. 2-25/99-Min.(II), dated 30th October, 1999.-- In pursuance of
the Proclamation of the Fourteenth day of October, 1999, and the Provisional
Constitution Order No. 1 of 1999, and in exercise of all other powers enabling
him in that behalf, the Chief Executive of, the Islamic Republic of Pakistan is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Order in respect of the powers and
functions of the Governors:
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1)
This Order may be called the Powers and Functions of the Governors Order (Order
No. 5 of 1999).
(2) It shall come into force at once.
2. Powers and functions of the Governors.--(1) Subject to the provisions of
clause (2) of Article 3 of the Provisional Constitution Order No. 1 of 1999,
the powers and functions of a Governor shall be the same as of a Governor under
the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, including the functions
and powers of a Chief Minister and such other powers and functions as may be
conferred upon him by the Chief Executive.
(2) The Governor of .the Province may, whenever he considers it
necessary, with the approval of the Chief Executive, or if so directed by the
Chief Executive, call upon the Armed Forces of Pakistan for such assistance and
performances of such functions, as deemed fit.
